description: iPayX (ipayx.ai) is an FX verification/audit product that compares bank-applied foreign-exchange rates against real-time mid-market rates.
access_notes: The ipayx.ai site describes a consumer-facing FX audit tool ('enter your transaction') rather than a self-serve developer API signup flow. A separate community MCP connector ('iPayX FX Audit') exists on Glama/mcpservers.org, but the primary site does not document programmatic API access, auth, or signup for developers.
api_notes: No developer API reference, endpoint list, or SDK documentation found on the official site; only a consumer-facing web interface was visible.
main_blocker: No public developer API documentation was found; the product appears to be a consumer-facing tool with a separate, unofficial MCP connector.
